name: flowing-menu
title: Flowing Menu
description: A big typographic list of links; hovering an item rolls a band over it from the edge the cursor entered, carrying a marquee of the item's words.

meta.reducedMotion: Hover shows the band instantly with still text.
meta.useWhen: Portfolio and studio navigation or project indexes with 3–8 entries.
meta.avoidWhen: Primary site navigation on product sites; long lists; touch-first audiences.
